title: 第九章 三关考核第十章 道有三宝
content_zh:
透过山门的缝隙，可以清楚的看到里面五座山峰之上各有一道霞光冲天而起，由远及近，瞬间就来到了山门之上，赫然是五个人直接御空飞行而来，出现在了所有人的面前。
看着空中居高临下站立的五人，人群顿时沸腾了。
“福地境才能施展飞行之术，天啊，该不会这五人全都是福地境吧？问道宗果然底蕴深厚！”
“福地境，根本不敢想的境界，要知道我们整个武阳城数十万人口，不过只有一个福地境的修士而已。”
姜云也同样被震惊到了，虽然他不是修士，但是这点常识还是知道的。
修道的前三个境界分别是通脉，福地和洞天，十万莽山有没有福地境的修士他不清楚，但是整个姜村，最强的爷爷姜万里也不过才是通脉九重而已。
％lM
眼前这问道宗，竟然一下就来了五个福地境的修士，四男一女，而且看年纪都不大，最年轻的那个相貌硬朗之人，好像都和自己年龄相仿，这让姜云有种强烈的感觉，自己来对地方了。
从问道宗飞出的这五人，站在空中，每个人身上散发出来的强大威压，就如同五座山岳一样，压得众人几乎都喘不过气来，不由自主的纷纷低下头去，根本不敢和其对视。
五人都是面无表情，目光冷冽的扫了一群众人之后，由最中间，也就是姜云看起来和自己年纪相仿的那名年轻人朗声开口道：“在下肖一书，今日我问道宗开山收徒，由我简单的和大家说下规矩。”
“我宗收徒不问年纪，不问修为，只有三关考核，分别考验道心、道灵和道体。”
说实话，原本姜云还有点担心，虽然自己不久前击败了通脉五重的风无忌，但自己毕竟只是凡人，不知道能否通过问道宗的考核。
但是现在听到肖一书直接开门见山点出不问修为，这才让他稍微安心。
“三关之中，过任意一关者，可拜入我问道宗作为杂役弟子；过任意两关者，可拜入我宗作为外门弟子；三关全过者，直接成为内门弟子！”
杂役，外门和内门！
三种不同弟子的身份，自然也代表了进入宗门之后所能享受到的待遇不同。
姜云不由自主的想到了风无忌，对方已经被轮回宗收为了内门弟子，从这点上来说，他的资质显然不错。
如果自己想要和他抗衡，那么最稳妥的方法就是最好也能成为内门弟子。
肖一书接着道：“考核过程当中会有危险存在，虽然不至于死亡，但是受伤倒是极有可能，故而诸位自己斟酌下自己的实力，莫要逞强好胜，如果出了什么意外的话，我宗概不负责。”
顿了顿，肖一书的面色突然一寒，语气之中多出几分肃杀之意道：“我问道宗，乃人族道宗，只收人族弟子，所以如果诸位之中有妖族的话，还请自觉离开，不要想着蒙混过关，等到收徒开始，一旦被我们发现，那别怪我们不客气了！”

妖族，姜云也听说过，天地之间，万物都有灵性，除了人族之外的其他族群，最常见的植物动物，甚至山川大河，都可修炼，一旦修炼有成，就为妖。
虽然人和妖同为生灵，但是秉承非我族类，其心必异的想法，所以自古以来，人族和妖族并不和睦，甚至基本上是处于敌对关系。
随着肖一书的话音落下，先前嘲讽过姜云的那位俊俏男子突然伸手一指姜云道：“你是妖族吧？”
姜云的眉头不禁微微一皱，眼中闪过了一道寒光，此人刚才讥讽自己就算了，现在竟然当着问道宗人的面，说自己是妖族！
虽然姜云没有没有什么为人处世的经验，但是他天生聪慧，知道此人和自己无冤无仇，对方不过是哗众取宠，想要借着打压自己来博得他人眼球，吸引他人注意罢了。
对于这样的人，要么就是强势反击，要么就是不加理会，而姜云在愤怒之后选择了后者，毕竟自己初来乍到，人生地不熟，多一事不如少一事，忍了。
俊俏青年的话除了引起一阵哄笑之外，却也引起了一些人的不忿，一名衣着朴素，身高马大的大汉实在忍不住开口道：“霍远，这位小兄弟是穿的怪点，但是你也没必要这么处处针对人家吧？”
名为霍远的俊俏青年顿时两眼一瞪道：“唐毅，你哪只眼睛看到我针对他了？我就是问他一句，谁让我们这里，就他穿的像个妖怪！”
“住口！”肖一书突然冷声开口，简单的两个字赫然如同两柄重锤，狠狠的砸在了霍远和唐毅两个人的身上。
两人同时发出一声闷哼，霍远“蹬蹬蹬”倒退几步，撞在了身后人的身上才勉强停下，而唐毅仅仅退了一步便一声大吼，硬生生的站住。
这样一来，两人自然谁也不敢说话，唐毅还好，但是霍远看向肖一书的目光之中，却是微不可查的闪过了一抹怨恨。
姜云的双眼微微眯起，这就是福地境的实力，仅仅两个字，竟然就能震退两名修士！
肖一书却根本不再理会两人，转而深深看了一眼姜云后便收回了目光，朗声道：“现在给你们最后十息时间，十息之后，开始考核！”
十息的时间显然是给那些妖族离开的，而果然有六七道身影以极快的速度窜出了人群，逃之夭夭，显然，他们就是妖族。
姜云却没有看那几道离开的人影，而是冲着刚才替自己说话的唐毅点了点头，算作谢意。
十息过去，肖一书再次朗声开口：“好，现在所有想要拜宗之人随我们进入宗门，无关人等在山门外等候！”
在场众人当中有不少都是送自己家族子弟前来，这些人是不允许进入问道宗的。
大部分人鱼贯进入了问道宗的山门，呈现在众人眼前的是一片面积极大的广场，足以容纳万人，地面之上有着一些线条粗大的纹路，而在广场的四角，各矗立着一座高达数十丈的兽形雕像。
四座兽雕不知道是何种凶兽，虽然外形各不相同，但都狰狞可怖，神态栩栩如生，给人的感觉，就像是随时能够活过来一样。
广场的外围，还围聚着数千人，从他们的服饰打扮上不难看出，他们都是问道宗的弟子。

作为三年一次的开山收徒，问道宗内的弟子自然也都想来看看热闹。
姜云趁机打量了下四周，虽然不少人留在了外面，但是此刻站在广场之内的人数也至少超过了两千。
这时，肖一书的声音响起：“第一关开始，向璇师妹，有劳！”
content_en:
Through the gap in the mountain gate, one can clearly see a ray of light rising into the sky from each of the five peaks inside. From far to near, they arrived at the mountain gate in an instant. Astonishingly, five people flew directly from the air and appeared in front of everyone.
Seeing the five people standing condescendingly in the sky, the crowd suddenly boiled.
"Only those in the blessed land realm can perform the art of flying. Oh my god, are these five people all in the blessed land realm? The Taoist sect really has a profound foundation!"
"The Blessed Land Realm is a realm that I can't even imagine. We have a population of hundreds of thousands in Wuyang City, but there is only one Blessed Land Realm monk."
Jiang Yun was also shocked. Although he was not a monk, he still knew this bit of common sense.
The first three realms of cultivation are Tongmai, Blessed Land and Cave Heaven. He doesn't know if there are monks in Shiwanmang Mountain who are in the Blessed Land realm, but in the entire Jiang Village, the strongest grandfather Jiang Wanli is only at the ninth level of Tongmai.
%lM
In front of the Taoist sect, there were actually five monks from the Blessed Realm, four men and one woman, who appeared to be relatively young. The youngest one, a tough-looking man, seemed to be about the same age as himself. This gave Jiang Yun a strong feeling that he had come to the right place.
The five people who flew out from Taoist Sect were standing in the air. The powerful pressure emanating from each of them was like five mountains. They were so heavy that everyone could hardly breathe. They lowered their heads involuntarily, not daring to look at them at all.
The five of them all had expressionless faces, and after scanning the crowd with cold eyes, the young man in the middle, who looked to be about the same age as Jiang Yun, said loudly: "I'm Xiao Yishu, today I am opening a Taoist sect and recruiting disciples. Let me briefly explain the rules to everyone."
"Our sect accepts disciples regardless of age or cultivation. There are only three assessments, which test Taoist heart, Taoist spirit and Taoist body respectively."
To be honest, Jiang Yun was a little worried at first. Although he had defeated Feng Wuji at the fifth level of Tongmai not long ago, he was only a mortal after all, and he didn't know whether he could pass the Taoist sect's assessment.
But now that he heard Xiao Yishu directly point out that he didn't care about his cultivation level, he felt a little relieved.
"Among the three tests, those who pass any one test can join our Taoist sect as miscellaneous disciples; those who pass any two tests can join our sect as our outer disciples; those who pass all three tests can directly become our inner disciples!"
Handyman, outer and inner doors!
The status of three different disciples naturally represents the different treatment they can enjoy after entering the sect.
Jiang Yun couldn't help but think of Feng Wuji, who had been accepted as an inner disciple by the Samsara Sect. From this point of view, his qualifications were obviously good.
If you want to compete with him, then the safest way is to become an inner disciple.
Xiao Yishu continued: "There will be dangers during the assessment. Although death will not occur, injury is very likely. Therefore, you should consider your own strength and don't be aggressive. If something happens, our sect will not be responsible."
After a pause, Xiao Yishu's face suddenly turned cold, and he said with a hint of murderous intent in his tone: "I am a Taoist sect, a human Taoist sect, and only accepts human disciples. So if there are demons among you, please leave voluntarily, and don't think about getting away with it until the recruitment of disciples begins. Once we find out, don't blame us for being rude!"
Jiang Yun has also heard about the demon race. Everything in the world has spirituality. In addition to the human race, other ethnic groups, the most common plants and animals, and even mountains and rivers, can cultivate. Once they succeed in cultivation, they become demons.
Although humans and demons are the same living beings, they adhere to the idea that people who are not our race must have different hearts. Therefore, since ancient times, the human race and the demon race have not been harmonious, and have even been basically in a hostile relationship.
As Xiao Yishu finished speaking, the handsome man who had previously mocked Jiang Yun suddenly pointed at Jiang Yun and said, "YouIs it a demon clan? "
Jiang Yun couldn't help but frown slightly, and a cold light flashed in his eyes. This man had just ridiculed himself, but now he actually said that he was a monster in front of the Taoist sect!
Although Jiang Yun has little experience in dealing with people, he is naturally smart and knows that this person has no enmity against him. The other person is just sensationalizing, trying to win the attention of others and attract their attention by suppressing himself.
For such a person, one has to either fight back strongly or ignore them, and Jiang Yun chose the latter after being angry. After all, he was a newbie here and was not familiar with the place. It was better to do less than to do more, so he tolerated it.
In addition to a burst of laughter, the handsome young man's words also aroused dissatisfaction among some people. A tall man with simple clothes couldn't help but said: "Huo Yuan, this little brother is dressed strangely, but you don't need to target others like this, right? "
The handsome young man named Huo Yuan suddenly glared and said, "Tang Yi, which of your eyes saw me targeting him? I just asked him, who asked us to be here? He was the only one dressed like a monster! "
"shut up! "Xiao Yishu suddenly spoke in a cold voice, and these two simple words were like two heavy hammers, hitting Huo Yuan and Tang Yi hard.
The two of them groaned at the same time. Huo Yuan took a few steps back and bumped into the person behind him before he barely stopped. Tang Yi only took a step back and then yelled and stopped abruptly.
As a result, neither of them dared to speak. Tang Yi was okay, but Huo Yuan looked at Xiao Yishu with a hint of resentment in his eyes.
Jiang Yun's eyes narrowed slightly. This is the strength of the blessed land realm. Just two words can actually repel two monks!
Xiao Yishu ignored the two of them at all, and took a deep look at Jiang Yun before retracting his gaze and said loudly: "Now I will give you the last ten breaths. After ten breaths, the assessment will begin! "
Ten breaths of time were obviously given to those monsters to leave, and as expected, six or seven figures jumped out of the crowd at extremely fast speeds and fled. Obviously, they were monsters.
Jiang Yun did not look at the leaving figures, but nodded to Tang Yi, who had just spoken for him, as a gesture of thanks.
After ten breaths passed, Xiao Yishu spoke loudly again: "Okay, now all those who want to worship the sect will follow us into the sect, and the uninvolved people are waiting outside the mountain gate! "
Many of the people present were here to send their own family members, and these people were not allowed to enter the Taoist Sect.
Most of the people filed into the mountain gate of Taoist Sect. What appeared in front of everyone was a large square, enough to accommodate ten thousand people. There were some thick lines on the ground, and at the four corners of the square, there stood a beast-shaped statue dozens of feet high.
The four beast sculptures don't know what kind of ferocious beasts they are. Although their appearances are different, they are all ferocious and terrifying, with lifelike expressions, giving people the feeling that they can come back to life at any time.
There were thousands of people gathered outside the square. It was easy to tell from their clothes that they were all disciples of the Taoist Sect.
As it is the first time to recruit disciples every three years, the disciples in the Taoist Sect naturally want to come and see the excitement.
Jiang Yun took the opportunity to look around. Although many people stayed outside, the number of people standing in the square at this moment was at least more than two thousand.
At this time, Xiao Yishu's voice sounded: "The first level has begun, Junior Sister Xiang Xuan, thank you! "
